The first day of TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 may have concluded, but there’s still plenty more Disrupt programming to come at San Francisco’s Moscone West October 14-15, and we’re offering a discount to match with there only being two days left in the event. You can now get two full days of Disrupt for 50% off across all ticket types, which makes it that much easier to catch some of our most captivating speakers and programming.
Just take the Disrupt Stage as an example. We still have stellar speakers like A-list actor Mark Wahlberg, Replit’s CEO Amjad Masad, all five Benchmark partners in a rare joint appearance, Amazon’s Panos Panay, Bluesky’s CEO and COO Toni Schneider and Rose Wang…the list goes on.
Plus, there are two flagship AI Stages, which bring OpenAI’s Head of Enterprise Product Alexander Embiricos to talk about the launch of their Dots agents, along with leaders from Anthropic, Hugging Face, Clay, and more.
That’s on top of all the 320+ exhibitors showcasing their startups in the packed and revamped Expo Hall, the extensive Breakouts and interactive Roundtable sessions that you can join in on, the networking opportunities, and ongoing side events across San Francisco. Plus, the Startup Battlefield 200 pitch competition is still going strong on the Disrupt Stage.
Yes, you’ll get less time to explore it all, but for half the price, that brings our most perk-filled ticket lineup to…
- Founder Pass: $550
- Attendee Pass: $525
- Investor Pass: $600
And for more of an entry-level experience at Disrupt, we have three other options…
- Non-profit: $250
- Student: $200
- Expo+: $175
If there’s ever a time to make that last-minute call to join Disrupt, now’s the time to act. If you’re a founder sitting on the fence and want to meet the investor who can secure the funding you need, make a connection with a potential co-founder, learn from those who have built before, or just broaden your community, this 50% discount is available right here. Don’t wait until there’s only one day left to join the excitement!
